items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: a pianist who worked with me way back in 1923... His name was Louis Bergerér.

ctx.x: Yes, that piano was sold to me -- I say "sold," it was almost given to me, by a pianist who worked with me way back in 1923, a Frenchman.
He became the manager and director of one of the biggest butter firms in France after. His name was Louis Bergerér.
